issue.title: CapturePanelModelTests refuse-override retry records three capture argv instead of two on macOS CI
issue.description:
Repo: bob-mac-capture (linked). macOS CI Test on master b2f24d05042a551d441ebcb142aa4dc5d5d15b22 (run 39268390857) fails `CapturePanelModelTests.testOlderBobRetriesSubmitWithoutRefuseOverride` at CapturePanelModelTests.swift:3295: `XCTAssertEqual failed: ("3") is not equal to ("2")` in 0.075s.

The test submits `=` with `FAKE_BOB_REFUSE_OVERRIDE_FLAG_UNSUPPORTED=1` and expects exactly two `argv=capture` invocations: the first with `--refuse-override`, the retry without. The recorded log has three capture invocations instead.

This is not the fakeBob live-preview timeout class tracked by bob-cli-4k (those fail after ~5s with "Condition not met before timeout"). It is also not bob-cli-8e's template-area failures or bob-cli-7p's copy-card crash. No existing task names this node.

Found while inspecting HIGHLIGHTS-unify CI (plan:202610/refs_inspector_unified_highlights.md). The feature commit does not touch CapturePanelModel or fake-bob refuse-override handling.

https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-mac-capture/actions/runs/39268390857

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Failed in 0.075s with a deterministic invocation-count assertion (3 != 2) at CapturePanelModelTests.swift:3295, not a waitUntil timeout. The sibling testOlderBobSubBulletHasNoTaskBlocks passed 0.003s later in the same suite, so this is a refuse-override retry count mismatch rather than a hung fake-bob. Observed on b2f24d0 run 39268390857 after Lint and Build passed and the Test step compiled.

issue.creation_reason: macOS CI on HIGHLIGHTS unify commit b2f24d0 fails testOlderBobRetriesSubmitWithoutRefuseOverride with a 3!=2 capture-invocation count, and no existing bead names that node.

payload.description: same CapturePanelModelTests CI reds; 9s is a 75ms argv-count mismatch, 4k is the fakeBob live-preview timeout class

evidence.note: Independent bob-cli-9v.land CI comparison: testOlderBobRetriesSubmitWithoutRefuseOverride still fails its invocation-count/flag assertions on 73d1106 run 39304814575, and on pre-epic 5fe90ea run 39283648975 (4 rather than 2 calls). Same retry-count defect; no reading-room changes to CapturePanelModel or fake-bob. Proposing bead: bob-cli-9v landing audit; no child proposal.
